name: saltline-arena
description: Saltline Arena: a free multiplayer browser FPS (port-yard free-for-all), derived from the Saltline restoration project.

scripts.build: npm run build:standalone && npm run build:world
scripts.format: prettier --write index.html "src/**/*.js" src/*.css vite.config.js vite.world.config.js scripts/*.mjs scripts/lib/*.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/hub.test.mjs && node tests/rtc.test.mjs && node tests/brawl.test.mjs && node tests/modes.test.mjs && node tests/ladder.test.mjs && node tests/soldier.test.mjs && node tests/mobile.test.mjs && node tests/brawl-e2e.test.mjs && node tests/rtc-e2e.test.mjs
